newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bosch-Siemens takes over Peruvian appliance firm.
newsitem.headline: Bosch-Siemens takes over Peruvian appliance firm.

text.p: German appliance maker Bosch-Siemens Hausgeraete GmbH has taken over Peru's largest appliance producer in an effort to improve its position in the Latin American market, the company said on Monday.
Coldex SA employs 350 workers and should have 1996 sales of about $27 million, said BSHG, a venture of Robert Bosch GmbH and Siemens AG.
BSHG said it would merge production and marketing activities of Coldex and Continental 2001, a Brazilian appliance maker it acquired two years ago. Continental has plants in Brazil and Mexico.
BSHG was expected to generate sales of about 8.6 billion marks ($5.5 billion) in 1996, less than the nine billion marks it had originally forecast.
Latin America and the Far East are seen as the most important growth markets for the company, BSHG chief Herbert Woerner recently said in a newspaper interview.
